content.text: CIME is thrilled to have successfully organised its 14th Clinical Simulation Educators' Programme!
We had the privilege of hosting 15 passionate and dedicated participants from various healthcare fields including Internal Medicine, Nursing, Radiology, Emergency Medicine, Anaesthesia and Oncology.
This five-day intensive programme was designed to empower educators in clinical simulation, equipping them with the latest tools, techniques, and knowledge to enhance their teaching skills.

Participants had the opportunity to engage in interactive hands-on simulation sessions and insightful discussions with experts in the field. They delved into a wide range of topics, including best practices in simulation-based education, scenario design, debriefing techniques, and much more!

The programme proved to be immensely valuable, with participants gaining a deeper understanding of the power and impact of simulation-based education. They left feeling inspired, invigorated, and armed with new strategies to elevate their teaching and improve patient care.
We extend our heartfelt congratulations to all the participants for their active engagement and commitment to professional development.

At CIME, we are committed to advancing healthcare education through innovative approaches, and the Clinical Simulation Educators' Programme is just one example of our dedication to nurturing the next generation of healthcare educators.
